messages:
maria-g: Hey team — heads up I'm converting from 1099 -> W2 starting 2026-04-05 and planning to move from CA to AZ the week before. Do we need to do anything re: WFH stipend proration or state tax nexus for Redwood? Payroll mentioned nexus might change.

alex-hr: Congrats! :party_parrot: Quick Qs — is your move date confirmed? Are you on our payroll or still contractor when you move?

maria-g: Move date 2026-04-03, conversion effective 2026-04-05. So I'll be contractor during move, employee after.

ben-people-ops: Ok — two things: 1) WFH stipend (monthly $100) is pro-rated on payroll cycles for employees; contractors get vendor reimbursement. 2) State tax withholding depends on your work state on your first day as W2. Since conversion is after move -> payroll will need AZ withholding. We'll need address + new W-4.

alex-hr: Steps: 1) submit new home address in Rippling, 2) upload signed W-4 and direct-deposit update, 3) I-9 in office or attest remote doc. Link: <https://redwoodintranet/people/relocation/contractor-to-employee-checklist>

maria-g: For the stipend, do I get partial March and April? March is contractor so reimbursements, April employee => prorated WFH for April payroll? worried about double-pay.

ben-people-ops: We avoid double-pay. Payroll will cancel the last contractor reimbursement if there's overlap; you should file expense for moving week and expense report tag "contractor-transition". For April: employee stipend will be prorated based on payroll start date (we pro-rate monthly on first payroll run). Example: start 4/5 in semi-monthly -> you'll get (days employed/total days) * $100.

payroll-bot: System notice: If employee_change_date and payroll_cycle overlap, manual adjustment required. Please CC payroll@redwood.com with final dates.

nate-eng: @maria-g fyi engineering needs to update access if you're changing contractor->employee for NDA/contract terms. Ping me once it's done.

maria-g: Thanks — I'll submit Rippling address + W-4 today and cc payroll. Who should I tag for vendor reimbursement cancel?

ben-people-ops: Tag payroll@redwood.com and copy finance-ops. We'll confirm cancellation. I can handle the stipend proration calc if you DM dates.

alex-hr: Also flag if you keep health coverage — benefits enrollment window opens day 1 of W2 with 30-day elect. We'll send enrollment packet.

maria-g: Awesome, thanks all! :heart: Sending docs now.
